ruleIntent: SSH should use version 2 where supported
description: Ensures remote CLI management is restricted to SSH version 2 protocol.
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.1, NIST AC-17, and DISA STIG NET-0400
applicability: All devices supporting SSH CLI management
notes: Validated against CIS Benchmark 1.1.1 and DISA STIG V-220527.

description: Prohibits unencrypted Telnet management across all virtual terminal lines.
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.2, NIST CM-7, and DISA STIG NET-0410
notes: Validated against CIS Benchmark 1.1.2 and DISA STIG V-220528.

ruleIntent: Unencrypted management HTTP should be disabled where HTTPS is available
description: Disables unencrypted web server administration to prevent cleartext credential transmission.
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.3, NIST SC-8, and DISA STIG NET-0420
notes: Validated against CIS Benchmark 1.1.3 and DISA STIG V-220529.

ruleIntent: Centralized AAA should be enabled where applicable
description: Requires centralized Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (RADIUS/TACACS+).
provenance: Derived from NIST IA-2, CIS Benchmark 1.1.4, and DISA STIG NET-0500
notes: Validated against NIST IA-2 and DISA STIG V-220530.

ruleIntent: Security-relevant logging should be forwarded to a remote collector where required
description: Verifies that event and audit logging is forwarded to an independent centralized logging repository.
provenance: Derived from NIST AU-12, CIS Benchmark 1.1.5, and DISA STIG NET-0600
notes: Validated against NIST AU-12 and DISA STIG V-220531.

ruleIntent: SNMPv1 should be disabled where secure alternatives are available
description: Prohibits the use of plaintext SNMPv1 communities to protect monitoring data and management control.
provenance: Derived from CIS Benchmark 1.1.6, NIST CM-7, and DISA STIG NET-0700
notes: Validated against CIS Benchmark 1.1.6 and DISA STIG V-220532.

ruleIntent: NTP time synchronization should be enabled to authoritative time sources
description: Ensures audit records and log stamps are precisely synchronized via NTP.
provenance: Derived from NIST AU-8 and DISA STIG NET-0800
applicability: All devices with internal clocks and logging
notes: Validated against NIST AU-8 and DISA STIG V-220533.

ruleIntent: Authorized access advisory banner must be presented before interactive login
description: Mandates configured login banner warning against unauthorized system access.
provenance: Derived from NIST AC-8 and DISA STIG NET-0900
applicability: Interactive CLI and Web access sessions
notes: Validated against NIST AC-8 and DISA STIG V-220534.

ruleIntent: HTTPS must be enabled when web management interface is present
description: Protects administrative web sessions with TLS cryptographic encryption.
provenance: Derived from NIST SC-8 and ISO 27001 A.8.24
applicability: Devices with web-based graphical management interfaces
notes: Validated against NIST SC-8 and CIS Cisco 1.1.3.

ruleIntent: Password minimum length must be at least 14 characters
description: Enforces minimum password length to resist credential brute-force attacks.
provenance: Derived from NIST IA-5 and DoD Password Guidelines
